Question Choices: Fill: A container is measured as 8 m long, 2 m wide and 5 m high. The volume is __ cubic meters (m³)
Hints: volume = length x width x height
Solution: 80 -> volume = length x width x height = 8 x 2 x 5 = 80

Question Choices: Fill: A box has a volume of 120 cm³. Its length is 5 cm and width is 4 cm. The height is __ cm.
Hints: volume = length x width x height. Reverse the operation to get the height
Solution: 6 -> volume = length x width x height. height = volume ÷ (width x length) = 120 ÷ (4 x 5) = 120 ÷ 20 = 6
